through N108 to 115 on the

rows:
The CF and machine
identification signal does not
match the NC's internal
information.

1. If the NC PCB has been replaced
and there is an internal data bank
change, check for a data setting error.
2. If the IO PCB has been replaced
and this alarm still triggers, make sure
that all connectors on the IO PCB
have been connected or that the latest
IO PCB is being used. If operation
does not restore, the PCB may be
faulty. Therefore, replace it with the
latest IO PCB.
3. If the CF has been replaced and this
alarm still triggers, check the machine
and the software version on the
version screen. If the wrong CF is
connected, the machine model name
does not display correctly. If the
wrong name appears, replace the CF
with the correct one.
